question: What is the title of the newly compiled book featuring Prime Minister Modi’s speeches on Indian culture and values?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sanskriti Ka Paanchva Adhyay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• PM Modi’s book on Indian culture Sanskriti Ka Paanchva Adhyay to be released in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A new book titled **"Sanskriti Ka Paanchva Adhyay"** is being released in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a **compiled collection of PM Narendra Modi’s speeches** on **culture, traditions, spirituality, and heritage**.

 
 
• 
 
The book is being formally released by **Acharya Mahamandaleshwar Pujya Swami Avdheshanand Giri Maharaj**, Head of the **Juna Akhara**.

 
 
• 
 
**Foreword** is written by **Ram Bahadur Rai**.

 
 
• 
 
The **compilation** is done by **Dr. Prabhat Ojha**.

 
 
• 
 
The **publisher** of the book is **Prabhat Prakashan**.
